tool_args.rationale: The probe breaks the pilot's vmax–rho collinearity. Fit the guided saturating siphon with a signed square-root branch over the full fallback bounds, then test it on fresh confirmation rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Beverton-Holt recruitment and bilinear mass action
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither accounts for the gradient dependence revealed by the discriminating probe.
The supplied subtree identifies the square-root branch as the open completion; its signed coefficient can be fitted directly.
The acquired gradient-leverage rows identify the three parameters of the guided model; further measurements are not needed before confirmation.
